default.Title: WhisPaste – Speech to Text & Voice Typing

_pricing_note: Price is set once, manually, in Partner Center > Pricing and availability — NOT here. WhisPaste's account is on Pricing V2 (Advanced Pricing Model); Microsoft's Submission API docs say outright it can't be used to write pricing for Pricing V2 accounts (every commit attempt with a Pricing.PriceId here failed with 'Price Tier is not supported', 2026-07-21). Both scripts/apply-store-metadata.mjs and scripts/submit-ms-store.ps1 (the classic-DevCenter-API submission script, replacing the msstore CLI as of v1.2.59 — see docs/store-release.md) deliberately leave Pricing untouched; a submission simply carries forward whatever price is already live. See ~/.claude/infrastructure/microsoft-partner-center.md §8/§9 for the full research trail.
